title: Gray Top & Black Mini with Knee Boots
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight light brown hair in a slight windblown motion stands in a full-length pose against a pale gray backdrop. She wears a fitted gray jersey top with draped front and an asymmetric hem, with a small pale purple rosette necklace. A black mini skirt with a front flap pocket and a zip detail, lace-top gray socks, and tall black buckled knee boots complete the look. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of warm gray, black, and pale lavender. Clean and sleek, in the style of a minimal streetwear lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The draped top and buckled boots are the key contrasts.
- Keep the windblown hair for a sense of movement.
tryThis: Try this: Keep the windblown hair for movement.
